model: Unrestricted uniform transposition, with correctly aligned frequency anchors. One pair of positive anchors always admits exactly one positive scale factor.
next_anchor_prediction: For another independently aligned Torah anchor x Hz, predict Haftarah anchor k*x Hz under uniform transposition. Test cents residual 1200*log2((y/b)/(x/a)). Require independently checked octave assignment, landmark identity, performer variation and estimation uncertainty.
falsification_scope: A supported nonzero residual excludes uniform transposition at the chosen landmarks. Zero residual at two landmarks leaves other parts of the melody unresolved. This is a conditional test design; the second aligned anchor is outstanding.
